info.name: V1.0
info.description:
# Bold Reports REST API v1.0 Overview

This Postman collection provides a comprehensive set of API endpoints for interacting with the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition v1.0, designed to streamline integration and management of reporting functionalities within your server environment. The collection is structured to align with the official Bold Reports [REST API v1.0](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#section/Introduction) documentation, enabling developers to authenticate, manage users, groups, items, permissions, settings, and audit logs efficiently.

## Key Features

- **Authentication**: Securely obtain a Bearer token using username and password credentials to authenticate API requests.
    
- **User Management**: Create, retrieve, update, delete, and activate/deactivate users, with support for bulk user imports via CSV.
    
- **Group Management**: Add, retrieve, update, delete, and manage user assignments within groups for efficient access control.
    
- **Item Management**: Handle reports, datasets, data sources, categories, and schedules, including operations like creation, updating, deletion, and exporting.
    
- **Permission Management**: Assign and manage permissions for users and groups on specific items, ensuring granular access control.
    
- **Settings Configuration**: Update email settings, generate embed secret keys, and manage branding for the Bold Reports instance.
    
- **Audit Logs**: Retrieve detailed activity logs for users, groups, permissions, comments, schedules, system settings, and items.
    

## Collection Structure

The collection is organized into the following key sections, each corresponding to critical API functionalities:

1. **Password Authentication**:
    
    - **Authenticate User**: POST request to retrieve a Bearer token using the `/token` endpoint.
        
2. **Users**:
    
    - **Add User**: POST request to create a new user.
        
    - **Get List of Users**: GET request to retrieve all users.
        
    - **Get Group Details of Particular User**: GET request to fetch group details for a specific user.
        
    - **Download CSV Template**: GET request to download a CSV template for bulk user imports.
        
    - **Add CSV User**: POST request to upload users via CSV.
        
    - **Get Specific User Detail**: GET request to retrieve details of a specific user.
        
    - **Edit User**: PUT request to update user details.
        
    - **Delete User**: DELETE request to remove a user.
        
    - **Activate or Deactivate User**: PUT request to toggle user activation status.
        
3. **Groups**:
    
    - **Add Group**: POST request to create a new group.
        
    - **Get List of Groups**: GET request to retrieve all groups.
        
    - **Get Specific Group Detail**: GET request to fetch details of a specific group.
        
    - **Edit Group**: PUT request to update group details.
        
    - **Delete Group**: DELETE request to remove a group.
        
    - **Add User(s) to Group**: POST request to add users to a group.
        
    - **Get List of Users from Group**: GET request to retrieve users in a group.
        
    - **Delete User(s) from Group**: DELETE request to remove users from a group.
        
4. **Items**:
    
    - **Get List of Items**: GET request to retrieve items like reports or datasets.
        
    - **Get Specific Item Detail**: GET request to fetch details of a specific item.
        
    - **Delete Item**: DELETE request to remove an item.
        
    - **Check Item Name Exists**: POST request to verify if an item name exists.
        
    - **Get Item Location**: GET request to retrieve an item's location.
        
    - **Add Category**: POST request to create a new category.
        
    - **Update Category**: PUT request to update a category.
        
    - **Add Report**: POST request to create a new report.
        
    - **Update Report**: PUT request to update a report.
        
    - **Download Items**: POST request to download items.
        
    - **Export Report**: POST request to export a report in formats like PDF.
        
    - **Export Report with Filters**: POST request to export a report with specified filters.
        
    - **Add Datasource**: POST request to create a new data source.
        
    - **Update Datasource**: PUT request to update a data source.
        
    - **Add Dataset**: POST request to create a new dataset.
        
    - **Update Dataset**: PUT request to update a dataset.
        
    - **Add Schedule**: POST request to create a schedule for an item.
        
    - **Get Scheduled Items**: GET request to retrieve scheduled items.
        
    - **Get Schedule Item Detail**: GET request to fetch details of a specific schedule.
        
    - **Update Schedule**: PUT request to update a schedule.
        
    - **Run Scheduled Report**: GET request to run a scheduled report immediately.
        
    - **Get All Tags**: GET request to retrieve all tags used in items.
        
    - **Get Report Parameters**: GET request to fetch parameters for a specific report.
        
5. **Permission**:
    
    - **Add User Permission**: POST request to assign permissions to a user for an item.
        
    - **Get List of User Permissions**: GET request to retrieve user permissions.
        
    - **Delete User Permission**: DELETE request to remove a user permission.
        
    - **Add Group Permission**: POST request to assign permissions to a group for an item.
        
    - **Get List of Group Permissions**: GET request to retrieve group permissions.
        
    - **Delete Group Permission**: DELETE request to remove a group permission.
        
6. **Settings**:
    
    - **Update Email Settings**: PUT request to configure email settings.
        
    - **Generate Embed Secret Key**: POST request to generate an embed secret key.
        
    - **Update Branding**: PUT request to update branding settings.
        
7. **Audit Logs**:
    
    - **All Activity Logs**: GET request to retrieve all activity logs.
        
    - **Group Activity Logs**: GET request to fetch group-related activity logs.
        
    - **Group Permission Activity Logs**: GET request for group permission logs.
        
    - **User Activity Logs**: GET request for user-related activity logs.
        
    - **User Permission Activity Logs**: GET request for user permission logs.
        
    - **Comment Activity Logs**: GET request for comment-related logs.
        
    - **Schedule Activity Logs**: GET request for schedule-related logs.
        
    - **System Settings Activity Logs**: GET request for system settings logs.
        
    - **Item Activity Logs**: GET request for item-related activity logs.
        

## Getting Started

To use this collection:

1. **Set Up Environment Variables**: Configure `base_url`, `tenant_name`, `username`, `password`, `access_token`, `user_mail`, `group_id`, `id`, `report-id`, `scheduleID`, `activitymodule`, `activity`, and `itemtype` in your Postman environment for seamless API calls.
    
2. **Authenticate**: Start with the "Authenticate User" request to obtain a Bearer token, required for all subsequent requests.
    
3. **Explore Endpoints**: Use the structured requests to manage users, groups, items, permissions, settings, or audit logs as needed.
    
4. **Refer to Documentation**: For detailed endpoint specifications, consult the official Bold Reports REST API v1.0 documentation at [Bold Reports Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#section/Introduction).
    

## Notes

- Ensure the `access_token` is updated regularly, as tokens may expire based on server configurations.
    
- The API endpoints follow the structure `{{base_url}}/reporting/api/site/{{tenant_name}}/v1.0/{endpoint}`, as outlined in the Bold Reports documentation.
    
- For testing, you can use the public demo server credentials provided in the Bold Reports documentation to generate an access token.
    
- The collection supports complex operations like bulk user imports via CSV and detailed schedule management for automated reporting.
    

This collection simplifies interaction with the Bold Reports v1.0 REST API, enabling developers to efficiently manage reporting resources. For further assistance, refer to the linked documentation or contact the Bold Reports support team.

item.name: Password Authentication

request.description:
This endpoint allows you to obtain a Bearer token for authentication by providing a username and password. The token is required for all subsequent API requests in the Bold Reports v1.0 REST API. This endpoint is part of the Password Authentication flow and is essential for securing access to other API operations.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Authenticate User ](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/PasswordAuthentication) Documentation.

item.description: The "Password Authentication" in the Bold Reports v1.0 Postman collection contains a single endpoint designed to facilitate secure authentication for accessing the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition API. This folder is critical for initiating API interactions, as it provides the mechanism to obtain a Bearer token required for all authenticated requests in the v1.0 API.

item.name: Users

request.description:
This endpoint creates a new user account in the Bold Reports system with specified details such as email, first name, last name, and password.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Add User](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_AddUserV2) Documentation.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Download CSV Template](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_DownloadCsvTemplate) Documentation.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Add CSV User ](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_CsvUserImport) Documentation.

This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific user identified by their email address.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Get Specific User Detail](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_GetUserDetailV2) Documentation.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Edit User](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_EditUser) Documentation.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Delete User](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_DeleteUser) Documentation.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Activate Or Deactivate User ](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Users_ActivateDeactivateuser) Documentation.

item.description: The "Users" in the Bold Reports v1.0 Postman collection contains nine endpoints focused on managing user accounts within the Bold Reports Enterprise Edition. For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Check Item Name Exists Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_IsItemNameExists).

This endpoint retrieves the storage location of a specific item identified by its ID.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Get Item Location Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_GetItemLocation).

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Update Report Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_UpdateReport).

query.description: Specifies the item ID of the report or the dataset to be downloaded.

request.description:
This endpoint downloads one or more items (e.g., reports, datasets) by their IDs.

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Download Items Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_DownloadReport).

For more details, refer to the [V1.0 - Add Datasource Documentation](https://help.boldreports.com/enterprise-reporting/rest-api-reference/v1.0/server-api-reference/#operation/Items_AddDataSource).

This endpoint creates a new dataset with specified details and data source mappings.
